prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: seamless game material base-color/albedo texture, square tile, for walnut live-edge console slabs and round coffee tables in a warm great room.
Primary request: create a natural warm walnut wood albedo tile. One solid continuous wood surface fills the full square, no margins.
Composition: orthographic top-down surface scan, all wood grain travels predominantly left-to-right along image X. Tight, fine pores and flowing subtle natural grain; small restrained knots, with organic brown and muted honey variation. Subdued medium walnut brown overall, visibly natural rather than procedurally perfect.
Lighting: perfectly uniform neutral diffuse illumination suitable for physically based material base color; no directional lighting, no highlights, no shadows, no ambient occlusion, no reflections.
Constraints: seamless and tileable on all four edges; continuous single solid timber surface, no plank seams or separate boards; no crosshatching, no grid, no checker pattern, no parquet, no burned lines, no live-edge outline; not a photograph of furniture. No text, no logos, no border, no background. Fine pores and realistic wood detail without stark black streaks.
visual_qa: Warm restrained walnut grain runs left to right. Fine pores and subtle knots; no plank joins, grid, baked light, shine, or furniture edges. Generated tile appears suitable for wood albedo; exact edge continuity is not proven by the generation.
